scripts.build: pnpm manifest && pnpm manifest:validate && tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/write-static-routes.mjs && node scripts/assert-no-production-fixtures.mjs
scripts.build:e2e: pnpm manifest && pnpm manifest:validate:local && tsc -b && vite build --mode e2e && node scripts/write-static-routes.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm test:release && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm test:coverage:layers && pnpm test:conformance && pnpm build
